title: next at done tells a session kept open by inbox entries or an authorized release to start a new session
symptom: After the move into done keeps the session open, because inbox entries are unfolded or release is authorized, chough next still names chough session new as the next command
trigger: Add an inbox entry (or grant release consent), advance into done, then run chough next
expected: next names chough inbox fold, then chough doctor --fix, for unfolded entries, and chough stage enter release for an authorized release; a new session only once the session has archived itself (REQ-cli-021 as delta correction 1 states it)
actual: next names chough session new <key> while the session is still open and active
steps: Advance a session to accept with its native change archived
Add an inbox entry without folding it, or grant release consent
Run chough stage advance, then chough next --json
impact: An agent following next opens a second session while the first still holds unfolded entries or an authorized release, leaving it open and the release undone
source: t37j's check of delta correction 1 against stage.rs done_action while drafting the delta corrections

notes.text: Red on the current done_action: TC-cli-next-at-done-kept-open fails, next names chough session new for a session kept open by an unfolded inbox entry; revision 7881bfb9 on leif/0.6.0-next-at-done-red.
